SELECT
      "group_revenue_monthly".entity "group_revenue_monthly__entity", sum("group_revenue_monthly".revenue_eur) "group_revenue_monthly__revenue_eur"
    FROM
      (SELECT * FROM intermediate.int_revenue_by_entity_month
WHERE revenue_stream <> 'Intercompany') AS "group_revenue_monthly"  WHERE (CAST("group_revenue_monthly".month || '-01' AS DATE) >= ?::timestamptz AND CAST("group_revenue_monthly".month || '-01' AS DATE) <= ?::timestamptz) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10000

SELECT
      "group_revenue_monthly".entity "group_revenue_monthly__entity", sum("group_revenue_monthly".revenue_eur) "group_revenue_monthly__revenue_eur"
    FROM
      (SELECT * FROM intermediate.int_revenue_by_entity_month
WHERE revenue_stream <> 'Intercompany') AS "group_revenue_monthly"  WHERE (CAST("group_revenue_monthly".month || '-01' AS DATE) >= ?::timestamptz AND CAST("group_revenue_monthly".month || '-01' AS DATE) <= ?::timestamptz) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10000

SELECT
      timezone('UTC', CAST("group_revenue_monthly".month || '-01' AS DATE)::timestamptz) "group_revenue_monthly__month"
    FROM
      (SELECT * FROM intermediate.int_revenue_by_entity_month
WHERE revenue_stream <> 'Intercompany') AS "group_revenue_monthly"  GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 DESC LIMIT 1

cubes.description: Revenue per entity, revenue stream and month in EUR, ex-VAT, as BOOKED in the ledgers. Finland from the Netvisor GL (NETVISOR journal only; the MIGRATION opening-balance batch is excluded upstream), including the webshop line (GL account 3040, UTC month, refunds not netted), Bergström Rör from the Fortnox export converted at the monthly average EUR/SEK rate. Group revenue as the finance handbook recognises it (webshop net of refunds, Helsinki time) is group_revenue_handbook_monthly.
